articles.title: ‘Reacher’ Star, 43, and Wife Call It Quits After 20 Years
articles.description: Michael Loccisano / Getty Images, Alan Ritchson, who wipes out bad men (and women) weekly on his hit show Reacher , announced Saturday on Instagram that he and his wife are splitting up after two decades of marriage. “After twenty years together, Cat and I have decided to end our marriage and continue alongside one another in a different way,” the couple wrote in a joint Instagram post. “We grew up together. We built a life and a family together. And we are raising three incredible boys who will always be the center of our world,” they added. “The best gift we can give one another—and our boys—right now is friendship ... and a commitment to becoming the strongest co-parents we can be.” They added that nothing could “diminish” the years they’ve spent together or “the love and respect we will always share.” The two met in high school and, after a brief teenage romance, reconnected in college before marrying in 2006. They offered no explanation for the split and asked for privacy. “Thank you for supporting us as we continue making the health and happiness of our family our priority,” they added in the post, which was signed “Cat and Alan.” Ritchson’s Prime Video series Reacher , which returned for a fourth season in August, is a massive global hit. Read it at People Read more at The Daily Beast.

articles.title: ‘Demon-possessed individual’: Trump loyalist drops bonkers explanation for JD Vance feud
articles.description: Influential MAGA influencer Laura Loomer took to social media Saturday to dispel claims that she disliked Vice President JD Vance, explaining that her long-running feud with the vice president was only her trying to protect him from “a demon possessed individual.” “For the record, I do not dislike Vice President Vance. I just have a really good judge of character and the demon possessed trust fund kid who lives in Maine and pals around with jihadists and calls President [Donald] Trump the anti-Christ is a threat to our Vice President,” Loomer wrote on X to her nearly 2 million followers, referencing right-wing figure Tucker Carlson. “Tucker literally admitted he was attacked by a demon. I am trying to protect our Vice President from a demon possessed individual who wants to drag our country to hell.” Carlson did, in fact, claim to have been "physically mauled” by a demon in a 2024 interview, an attack, he claimed, that left him “bleeding and with still-visible scars,” according to Mediaite . Loomer has attacked Vance in the past on a range of issues, including for being “ friends with degenerates ,” and for compromising Republicans’ 2026 midterm prospects. Vance has also clapped back at Loomer, calling her attacks “disgraceful” earlier this year. And yet, Loomer insisted Saturday night that she held no grudge against Vance, and actually cared deeply about him. “I am trying to help our President and Vice President because I care about them,” Loomer wrote. “I wish people would understand.” A self-described “ proud Islamophobe ,” Loomer has a long history of making overtly racist and bigoted remarks, particularly against Muslims . Despite her frequent controversial remarks, she’s continued to wield “ breathtaking influence ” in the Trump White House, having played an outsized role in the administration’s mass firings and immigration policies . For the record, I do not dislike Vice President Vance. I just have a really good judge of character and the demon possessed trust fund kid who lives in Maine and pals around with jihadists and calls President Trump the anti-Christ is a threat to our Vice President.
